# Paired differences between policies

**Generated by `scripts/paired_statistics.py` from `comparison.csv`. Do not edit by hand.**

Each figure is the mean over seeds of (first policy - second policy) on the same seed, with its 95% t-interval. Negative means the first policy lost fewer units or responded sooner. **An interval containing zero is a difference these runs cannot tell from noise.** `better / worse` counts the seeds on which the first policy was lower / higher.
